# Commit Message Guidelines

When generating git commit messages:

- Follow Conventional Commits format
- Use:

<type>(<scope>): <subject>

<body>

Allowed types:
- feat
- fix
- refactor
- perf
- docs
- test
- chore

Rules:
- Subject must be English
- Max 72 characters
- No emojis
- Body should explain why, not what
